fetch_ollama_models: fetch ollama models from the ollama API and return a list of model dictionaries with id, name, tags, and connection type
fetch_openai_models: fetch openai models from the openai API and return the list of model data entries
get_all_base_models: get all base models from openai, ollama, and function sources concurrently and return them as a combined list
get_all_models: get all models including base, custom, arena, and function-enhanced models with access control metadata for a user
get_filtered_models: filter models by user role and access control rules, returning only models the user is allowed to read
